worldcombat.skill.twister.summary: Raises a lasting vortex at the chosen spot: foes inside are dragged toward the eye and lifted off the ground while a wind blade cuts them every few moments. Step out and it stops hurting; a solid cut may leave them flinched. Holding style lasts longer and pulls harder; burst style is shorter and sharper.
worldcombat.skill.twister.use.0: Lock down a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.twister.use.1: Pull foes out of cover into the open
worldcombat.skill.twister.use.2: Interrupt foes caught in the ring
worldcombat.skill.twister.use.3: Repeated damage in a small area
worldcombat.skill.twister.description.0: Cuts a wind blade every %2$s s for about %1$s special damage to each foe inside; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.twister.description.1: The vortex covers a %1$s block radius and spins in place for %2$s s; its caster cannot move while maintaining it.
worldcombat.skill.twister.description.2: Pulls foes inside %1$s blocks toward the eye each tick; each wind blade then lifts the grounded foes it hits by %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.twister.description.3: Places the vortex on ground within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.twister.description.4: Each solid cut has a %1$s chance to make its target flinch for %2$s: the flinch first interrupts any action it can still interrupt, and during it the target cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks; each foe can be flinched at most once per vortex.
worldcombat.skill.twister.hold.on: Holding vortex on: it spins longer and pulls harder, but each blade deals about 15%% less and the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.twister.hold.off: Holding vortex off (burst gust): the vortex is shorter and pulls weaker, but each blade deals about 20%% more and the cooldown is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.twister.timing: Cast onto ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.twister.growth.0: At level %1$s the wind blade rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.twister.growth.1: At level %1$s the wind blade rises to %2$s power, a %3$s block radius and %4$s s of spinning.
worldcombat.skill.twister.preference.hol: On: the vortex spins longer and pulls harder, but each blade deals about 15%% less and the cooldown is longer, for locking down ground. Off: shorter with a weaker pull, but each blade deals about 20%% more and the cooldown is shorter.
The companion considers Twister only while a foe is this close; higher opens at range but the target can more easily step out of the ring.
With this on, the companion raises Twister when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, catching them together; off keeps the normal attack order.
